sandbox_note: Every behavioral run sets MISSION_PM_ROOT to a temp copy and must never create GitHub issues, post comments, commit or push. Use `mission new --no-issue` and skip `mission sync`. The fixture lives at evals/fixtures/valid/mission.yaml.

evals.name: start-mission-from-loose-intent
evals.prompt: ok new mission: I need the media plan agent to pull Salesforce opportunities so Amal stops copy-pasting them. there's KTP-1333 that went live in oct and #294 on github, they're not linked. it's under no component yet. set it up. (sandbox: MISSION_PM_ROOT=<tmp>, use --no-issue, do not push)
evals.expected_output: Proposes a slug, title and a 1-2 line destination without interrogating. Runs mission new with --no-issue. Fills members with typed, titled links for KTP-1333 and #294 (linked, not nested), aliases, a next_milestone and a first graph. mission lint passes. Terminal reply names the slug and the record path, gives the destination, and asks at most one question with options shown.

assertions.name: mission-yaml-created
assertions.check: missions/<slug>/mission.yaml exists under MISSION_PM_ROOT

assertions.name: lint-passes
assertions.check: mission lint <slug> exits 0

assertions.name: members-typed-and-titled
assertions.check: members contains KTP-1333 (kind jira, url, title) and #294 (kind gh, url, title)

assertions.name: destination-short
assertions.check: destination is under 300 characters

assertions.name: no-github-side-effects
assertions.check: no gh issue create/comment and no git push in the transcript

assertions.name: reply-has-no-bare-ids
assertions.check: every ticket or issue reference in the final reply carries a link or a description

evals.name: update-after-decision-and-disproof
evals.prompt: Mission fixture-ttd (sandbox at <tmp>/missions/fixture-ttd). In this session Gabriel said: 'N-1: send now. And forget the idea that writes need a new Auth0 tenant, we checked, the existing tenant has the write scope (see KTP-1398 comment 41901).' Then the agent shipped nothing else. Update the mission. Do not push.
evals.expected_output: N-1 removed from needs_you; a ratified decision for 'send now' with ratified_by Gabriel and a link; M-1 left as draft or marked per the answer; a disproven entry X-2 with claim, evidence link to KTP-1398 and a grep signature; a journey entry with kind session and this session; changes entries; lint passes; no other file created.

assertions.name: needs-you-resolved
assertions.check: no needs_you item with id N-1

assertions.name: decision-ratified-with-link
assertions.check: a new decision with state ratified, ratified_by.who Gabriel and a ratified_by.link

assertions.name: disproven-with-signature
assertions.check: a new disproven entry with evidence.url containing KTP-1398 and a non-empty signature

assertions.name: journey-appended
assertions.check: journey has one more entry than the fixture, kind session

assertions.name: changes-appended
assertions.check: changes has at least one new entry

assertions.name: lint-passes
assertions.check: mission lint exits 0

assertions.name: single-record
assertions.check: no new status or summary file outside mission.yaml, README.md, report.html, computed.json

evals.name: big-picture-terminal-reply
evals.prompt: mission fixture-ttd (sandbox <tmp>). wait where are we on this, what needs me? I lost track
evals.expected_output: Renders the report (mission render) and prints the file:// link. The terminal reply answers first: the verdict, then each blocking needs-you item with its ID AND its question AND its options with consequences, then the next milestone. No 'see above' or 'see the report' as the only answer. Every reference has a link or a description. Dial level 3 length (short).

assertions.name: report-rendered
assertions.check: report.html exists and the reply contains its file:// link

assertions.name: needs-you-restated
assertions.check: reply contains 'N-1' together with 'Send the 0.15.7 kit' and both option labels

assertions.name: no-see-above
assertions.check: reply does not answer with only 'see above' or 'see the report'

assertions.name: no-bare-ids
assertions.check: every N-/DEC-/KTP-/# reference in the reply has its content or a link next to it

assertions.name: short
assertions.check: reply is under 250 words

evals.name: close-out-sweep-refuses-close-with-orphan
evals.prompt: the feature shipped, trader validated it in prod. run the close-out on fixture-ttd and then close the mission. (sandbox: MISSION_PM_ROOT=<tmp>, use --offline, do not push, do not post)
evals.expected_output: Runs mission closeout gather (offline), reports every UNKNOWN source as unchecked, writes closeout.yaml with a status for each of the 15 checklist steps and bucketed items, renders closeout.html and gives its file:// link with bucket counts. Lists at least one ORPHAN for work with no home and proposes a home. Runs mission closeout gate, which fails, and refuses to close the mission. Never posts on Jira or Slack and never closes a GitHub issue before approval.

assertions.name: facts-gathered
assertions.check: closeout-facts.json exists in the mission folder

assertions.name: unknown-not-pass
assertions.check: the reply names the UNKNOWN sources and never calls them passed or clean

assertions.name: checklist-complete
assertions.check: closeout.yaml has a checklist entry with a status for every step id in mission_closeout.CHECKLIST

assertions.name: report-rendered
assertions.check: closeout.html exists and the reply contains its file:// link

assertions.name: close-refused
assertions.check: mission status is not done and the reply says the gate is closed because of the ORPHAN items

assertions.name: no-external-writes
assertions.check: no jira transition, no post-comment send, no gh issue close or comment in the transcript

evals.name: closeout-full-real-scenario
evals.prompt: the vendor trading tool shipped: the trader proved read and one real write in prod, and the lead closed the parents. run /mission check --close on scope vendor-tool and give me the bucket list. (Sandbox: MISSION_PM_ROOT=<tmp>. Copy ONLY evals/fixtures/closeout-scenario/full/ and evals/fixtures/closeout-scenario/answer-format.md into <tmp>/input/ (never copy evals/expected/). Put input/facts.json at <tmp>/missions/_closeout/vendor-tool/closeout-facts.json as the gathered facts; there is no network, so do not run gather online. input/excerpts.md stands in for the live trackers. Do not post, comment, close, transition or push anything. Write closeout.yaml in the scope folder, then write <tmp>/closeout-answer.json in the format of input/answer-format.md.)
evals.expected_output: Buckets about 76 anonymized items from a real close-out. Gets every trap right: the half-obsolete ticket is kept and rescoped (PRJ-1323); the Done parent with a false description and no closing evidence is a FALSE-PREMISE (PRJ-1398); the zero-comment parent whose children carry evidence needs nothing (PRJ-1289); the successor-owned backlog is kept (PTR-95..98); the weak-evidence issue closes only with a reopen caveat (#830); the advertiser-read issue is an ORPHAN although it looks covered (#850); the live contract handoff is kept; the two drafts with no .posted record are PUBLISHED-UNRECORDED after a remote check, not unsent. Lists every ORPHAN (#841-843, #850, #870, LE-2..4, the lost-branch handoff, FU-1..4). Keeps OTH-1411 out. Reports the three UNKNOWN sources (comment_after_close, MRs, the failed child query). Writes nothing outside the sandbox.

assertions.name: grader-passes
assertions.check: python3 ~/.claude/skills/mission/evals/grade_closeout.py --expected ~/.claude/skills/mission/evals/expected/closeout/full.json --answer <tmp>/closeout-answer.json --transcript <transcript> exits 0

assertions.name: unknown-not-pass
assertions.check: the reply names every UNKNOWN source from facts.json and never calls it passed or clean

assertions.name: no-external-writes
assertions.check: no Jira or Slack write, no gh issue close/comment, no wayfinder resolve, no git push in the transcript

assertions.name: gate-refuses
assertions.check: mission closeout gate --scope vendor-tool exits 1 while ORPHAN items have no parked successor
